pillars.name: Career Reflection
pillars.definition: Apply when the post is a reflective, narrative-voice account of professional experience, past or current, a former job, product, team, credential earned, or the Straventis consulting journey itself. Does NOT apply if the post is about an active, in-progress job search, use Job Search & Career Transition instead.

pillars.name: Job Search & Career Transition
pillars.definition: Apply when the post discusses the author's current job search, applying, interviewing, ATS systems, rejection, layoffs, or being open to work, present tense, unresolved.

pillars.name: AI/ML
pillars.definition: Apply when the core subject is a general AI/ML concept, model, or tool, cloud-based or software-context. Does NOT apply if the application is specifically automotive, industrial, or embedded/edge hardware, use Automotive & Industrial AI instead. Does NOT apply if the post is about organizational/platform structure to support AI, use Platform Engineering instead.

pillars.name: Automotive & Industrial AI
pillars.definition: Apply when the post concerns AI/perception applications specifically in automotive, industrial, or embedded/edge hardware contexts, ADAS, edge inference, sensor fusion, LiDAR, computer vision, or safety-critical (ASIL) systems. Does NOT apply to general-purpose or cloud/software AI content, use AI/ML instead.

pillars.name: Innovation & Industry News
pillars.definition: Apply when the post responds to a current event, published article, or draws a historical/comparative parallel to make a broader innovation point. Does NOT apply if the reaction is a specific AI/ML technical claim, use AI/ML instead.

pillars.name: Personal Story
pillars.definition: Apply when the post is a first-person narrative rooted outside professional project work, personal milestones, mentoring, life experience woven into a point. Does NOT apply to Straventis or employer-linked stories, use Career Reflection instead.

pillars.name: Platform Engineering
pillars.definition: Apply when the post argues for or explains how systems, data, or organizational structure should support technology at enterprise scale. Does NOT apply if the application is domain-specific automotive/edge hardware, use Automotive & Industrial AI instead.

pillars.name: Product Development
pillars.definition: Apply when the post is about building, shipping, or measuring a specific product or feature, roadmap decisions, ROI, or analytics used to evaluate success.

pillars.name: Program Management
pillars.definition: Apply when the post discusses goal-setting frameworks, formal program/project practice per PMBOK areas, or cross-organizational execution discipline.
